title: Base change of an integral algebra is integral
statement: Let $R\to S$ and $R\to R'$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings. If $S$ is integral over $R$, then $R'\otimes_RS$ is integral over $R'$ (for the ring map $r'\mapsto r'\otimes1$).
